ask: Set Cloudflare records for seatwise, hq and the wildcard to DNS only, or turn off Web Analytics auto setup and bot JavaScript detections
why: Cloudflare adds its own scripts to every page on your subdomains. They show errors, so no product can pass its launch check. It also goes against your rule of no proxies.
ifNo: No product the company builds can launch.
title: Turn off Cloudflare's proxy for your subdomains
youDo: In Cloudflare, open DNS for anchit-tandon.com and switch the records for seatwise, hq and * (the wildcard) from Proxied (orange cloud) to DNS only (grey cloud). About 2 minutes.
